```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(skimr)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(viridis)
```
## -- Solution to Problem 1 -- ##
```{r}
FDS <- read_csv("data_fastfood_sales.csv")

FDC <- read_csv("data_fastfood_calories.csv")
```

```{r}
FDS %>% mutate(POFS = num_franchised_stores/unit_count) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = us_sales, y = unit_count, color = POFS)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") + 
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10") + 
  labs(x = "U.S sales in millions |n (log10 scale)", y = "Total numbers of stores |n (log10 scale)", color = "POFS") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = us_sales, y = unit_count, label = restaurant), color="black")
```
## -- Solution to Problem 2 -- ##
```{r}
ggplot(FDS, aes(x = average_sales,
                  y = reorder(restaurant, average_sales))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels=scales::dollar_format()) +
  geom_text(aes(label=dollar(round(average_sales, 0))), position=position_dodge(width=0.9), hjust= -0.1, vjust=0.50) +
  labs(x = "Average scales per unit (in thousands)",
       y = "Restaurant") +
  theme_classic()
```

## -- Solution to Problem 3 -- ##

```{r}
ggplot(data = FDC, mapping = aes(x = calories, y=sodium, label = item)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~restaurant, nrow=3) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2300, size = 1) + labs(x = "Calories",  y = "Sodium (mg)") +
  geom_text_repel(data = FDC %>% filter(sodium > 2300), 
                  size=2,
                  min.segment.length = 1,
                  max.iter = 2000,
                  max.overlaps = Inf,
                  ylim = c(2300, NA),
                  nudge_y = 1000, 
                  nudge_x = 2000
  )   +
  theme_bw()
```
## -- Solution to Problem 4 -- ##

```{r}
FDC %>%
  mutate(is.salad = str_detect(string = item, pattern = "Salad")) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = calories,
                       y = reorder(restaurant, calories, FUN=median)),
         color = is.salad) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = is.salad)) +
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("Not a salad", "Salad"), values = c("#F8766D", "#00BFC4")) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10") +
  labs(y = "Restaurant",
       x = "Calories (log10 scale)",
       color = "Is the entree \na salad") +
  theme_bw()
```

## -- Solution to Problem 5 -- ##

```{r}
FDC1 <- FDC %>%
  filter(restaurant != "Taco Bell") %>% 
  group_by(restaurant) %>% 
  mutate(sugar_med = median(sugar)) %>% 
  inner_join(FDS, by = "restaurant") %>%
  select(restaurant, us_sales, sugar_med) %>% 
  unique()

ggplot(FDC1, aes(x=reorder(restaurant, us_sales), 
                     y= us_sales)) + 
  geom_bar(aes(fill = sugar_med), stat='identity') +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Restaurant") +
  ylab("U.S. sales (in millions)") +
  labs(fill = "Median sugar (grams) \n in fast food entrees")
```
